```{r USER EDIT THIS CHUNK ONLY}
## Path for your Network data manifest
excel_path <- "NetworkExplorerMelanoma.xlsx"
is_bipartite <- FALSE
user_palette <- FALSE
```


```{r}
node_metadata <- readxl::read_excel(excel_path, sheet = 1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Node_Name = as.character(Node_Name),
    Node_Label = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(Node_Label) | Node_Label == "" ~ as.character(Node_Name),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Node_Label)
    ),
    Color_Factor = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(Color_Factor) | Color_Factor == "" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(Color_Factor)
    ),
    Shape_Factor = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(Shape_Factor) | Shape_Factor == "" ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ as.character(Shape_Factor)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Node_Name, Node_Label, Color_Factor, Shape_Factor) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Node_Name, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Node_Name), Node_Name != "")

selected_nodes <- node_metadata$Node_Name

node_data <- readxl::read_excel(excel_path, sheet = 2) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Node = as.character(Node),
    Observation = as.character(Observation),
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Node, Observation, Value)

node_mask_raw <- readxl::read_excel(excel_path, sheet = 3)

masked_observations <- tibble::tibble(
  Observation = as.character(node_mask_raw[[4]]),
  Mask = dplyr::coalesce(as.logical(node_mask_raw[[5]]), FALSE)
) |>
  dplyr::filter(Mask, !is.na(Observation), Observation != "") |>
  dplyr::distinct(Observation)

masked_nodes <- tibble::tibble(
  Node = as.character(node_mask_raw[[1]]),
  Mask = dplyr::coalesce(as.logical(node_mask_raw[[2]]), FALSE)
) |>
  dplyr::filter(Mask, !is.na(Node), Node != "") |>
  dplyr::distinct(Node)

node_data_filtered <- node_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !Observation %in% masked_observations$Observation,
    !Node %in% masked_nodes$Node
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Node, Observation, Value)

compute_correlation_pvalues <- function(value_matrix) {
  pairwise_counts <- crossprod(!is.na(value_matrix))
  cor_matrix <- stats::cor(value_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  cor_squared <- pmin(cor_matrix^2, 1)
  denominator <- pmax(1 - cor_squared, .Machine$double.eps)
  t_stat <- cor_matrix * sqrt(pmax(pairwise_counts - 2, 0) / denominator)
  pval_matrix <- 2 * stats::pt(-abs(t_stat), df = pmax(pairwise_counts - 2, 1))
  pval_matrix[pairwise_counts < 3] <- NA_real_
  diag(pval_matrix) <- 0
  pval_matrix
}

if(is_bipartite) {
  bipartite_edges <- node_data_filtered |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      from = paste0("node::", Node),
      to = paste0("obs::", Observation)
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(from, to, value = Value)

  bipartite_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    bipartite_edges,
    bipartite_edges |>
      dplyr::mutate(from_rev = to, to_rev = from) |>
      dplyr::select(from = from_rev, to = to_rev, value)
  )

  bipartite_ids <- union(unique(bipartite_edges$from), unique(bipartite_edges$to))
  cormat_wide <- stats::xtabs(
    value ~ from + to,
    data = bipartite_edges |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        from = factor(from, levels = bipartite_ids),
        to = factor(to, levels = bipartite_ids)
      )
  ) |>
    as.matrix()

  node_display_metadata <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    node_data_filtered |>
      dplyr::distinct(Node) |>
      dplyr::rename(Node_Name = Node) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Node_ID = paste0("node::", Node_Name),
        Partition = "Node"
      ),
    node_data_filtered |>
      dplyr::distinct(Observation) |>
      dplyr::rename(Node_Name = Observation) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Node_ID = paste0("obs::", Node_Name),
        Partition = "Observation"
      )
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(node_metadata, by = "Node_Name") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Node_Label = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(Node_Label) | Node_Label == "" ~ Node_Name,
        TRUE ~ Node_Label
      )
    )

  node_display_metadata$Node_Label <- make.unique(node_display_metadata$Node_Label)
  node_display_metadata <- node_display_metadata |>
    dplyr::select(Node_ID, Node_Name, Node_Label, Color_Factor, Shape_Factor, Partition)
} else {
  selected_nodes <- intersect(selected_nodes, unique(node_data_filtered$Node))
  if(length(selected_nodes) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No unmasked nodes from Metadata$Node_Name remain after filtering. ",
      "Check the Data_Mask sheet or the Node_Name values in the Metadata sheet."
    )
  }
  if(length(selected_nodes) < 2) {
    stop(
      "At least two unmasked nodes from Metadata$Node_Name are required to compute correlations. ",
      "Check the Data_Mask sheet or the Node_Name values in the Metadata sheet."
    )
  }

  node_value_matrix <- node_data_filtered |>
    dplyr::filter(Node %in% selected_nodes) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Node, values_from = Value) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Observation") |>
    as.matrix()

  translated_labels <- node_metadata$Node_Label[match(colnames(node_value_matrix), node_metadata$Node_Name)]
  translated_labels[is.na(translated_labels)] <- colnames(node_value_matrix)[is.na(translated_labels)]
  translated_labels <- make.unique(translated_labels)

  cor_matrix <- cor(node_value_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  pval_matrix <- compute_correlation_pvalues(node_value_matrix)
  rownames(cor_matrix) <- translated_labels
  colnames(cor_matrix) <- translated_labels
  rownames(pval_matrix) <- translated_labels
  colnames(pval_matrix) <- translated_labels
  cormat_wide <- cor_matrix

  node_display_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
    Node_ID = translated_labels,
    Node_Name = colnames(node_value_matrix)
  ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      node_metadata |>
        dplyr::select(Node_Name, Color_Factor, Shape_Factor),
      by = "Node_Name"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Node_Label = Node_ID,
      Partition = "Correlation"
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(Node_ID, Node_Name, Node_Label, Color_Factor, Shape_Factor, Partition)
}

cormat_wide[is.na(cormat_wide)] <- 0

if(is_bipartite) {
  pval_wide <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(cormat_wide), ncol = ncol(cormat_wide),
                      dimnames = dimnames(cormat_wide))
  fdr_significant_pairs <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = nrow(cormat_wide), ncol = ncol(cormat_wide),
                                  dimnames = dimnames(cormat_wide))
} else {
  pval_wide <- pval_matrix
  fdr_significant_pairs <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = nrow(pval_wide), ncol = ncol(pval_wide),
                                  dimnames = dimnames(pval_wide))
  upper_tri_mask <- upper.tri(pval_wide) & is.finite(pval_wide) & pval_wide > 0
  if(any(upper_tri_mask)) {
    adjusted_upper_pvalues <- stats::p.adjust(pval_wide[upper_tri_mask], method = "BH")
    fdr_significant_pairs[upper_tri_mask] <- adjusted_upper_pvalues <= 0.2
    fdr_significant_pairs <- fdr_significant_pairs | t(fdr_significant_pairs)
  }
}

node_average_values <- node_data_filtered |>
  dplyr::group_by(Node) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Average_Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

node_average_lookup <- node_display_metadata |>
  dplyr::select(Node_ID, Node_Name, Partition) |>
  dplyr::left_join(node_average_values, by = c("Node_Name" = "Node")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Average_Value = dplyr::if_else(
      Partition == "Observation",
      NA_real_,
      Average_Value
    )
  )

node_average_lookup <- stats::setNames(
  node_average_lookup$Average_Value,
  node_average_lookup$Node_ID
)

cormat <- as.data.frame(as.table(cormat_wide)) |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  dplyr::rename(
    Var1 = dplyr::any_of(c("Var1", "from")),
    Var2 = dplyr::any_of(c("Var2", "to")),
    value = dplyr::any_of(c("Freq", "value"))
  )
```

```{r}
cluster_louvain_stable <- function(graph, seed = 1L) {
  had_seed <- exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  if(had_seed) {
    original_seed <- get(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)
  }
  on.exit({
    if(had_seed) {
      assign(".Random.seed", original_seed, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    } else if(exists(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv, inherits = FALSE)) {
      rm(".Random.seed", envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }, add = TRUE)
  set.seed(as.integer(seed))
  igraph::cluster_louvain(graph)
}

map_edge_colors <- function(weights, positive_only = FALSE, negative_only = FALSE) {
  if(length(weights) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }

  if(positive_only) {
    edge_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Reds"))(201)
    max_weight <- max(weights, na.rm = TRUE)
    if(!is.finite(max_weight) || max_weight <= 0) {
      return(rep(edge_palette[[101]], length(weights)))
    }
    color_idx <- round((weights / max_weight) * 200) + 1
  } else if(negative_only) {
    edge_palette <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(201)
    max_weight <- max(abs(weights), na.rm = TRUE)
    if(!is.finite(max_weight) || max_weight <= 0) {
      return(rep(edge_palette[[101]], length(weights)))
    }
    color_idx <- round((abs(weights) / max_weight) * 200) + 1
  } else {
    edge_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(201)
    max_weight <- max(abs(weights), na.rm = TRUE)
    if(!is.finite(max_weight) || max_weight <= 0) {
      return(rep(edge_palette[[101]], length(weights)))
    }
    color_idx <- round(((weights + max_weight) / (2 * max_weight)) * 200) + 1
  }

  color_idx[!is.finite(color_idx)] <- 101L
  color_idx <- pmin(pmax(color_idx, 1L), 201L)
  edge_palette[color_idx]
}

recompute_network <- function(cormat, pval_matrix, cutoff, cluster = NA,
                              filter_pos_corr, filter_neg_corr, filter_singletons,
                              color_nodes_by_average = FALSE,
                              filter_significant_edges = FALSE) {

  if(filter_significant_edges) {
    cormat[!fdr_significant_pairs] <- 0
  }

  if(filter_neg_corr) {
    cormat[cormat < 0] <- 0
  } else if(filter_pos_corr) {
    cormat[cormat > 0] <- 0
  }
  
  cor_network <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(as.matrix(cormat),
                                                     diag = FALSE,
                                                     mode = "max",
                                                     weighted = TRUE)

  cluster <- as.numeric(cluster)
  cor_network <- cor_network |>
    igraph::set_edge_attr("true_weight",value = igraph::E(cor_network)$weight) |>
    igraph::set_edge_attr("weight",
                          value = sapply(igraph::E(cor_network)$weight, function(x) {
                            ifelse(abs(x) > cutoff,return(abs(x)), return(0))
                          }))
  cor_network <- 
    igraph::delete_edges(cor_network, which(igraph::E(cor_network)$weight == 0))
  if(igraph::ecount(cor_network) > 0) {
    igraph::E(cor_network)$color <- map_edge_colors(
      igraph::E(cor_network)$true_weight,
      positive_only = filter_neg_corr,
      negative_only = filter_pos_corr
    )
  }
  if(filter_singletons) {
    nodes_to_remove <- which(igraph::degree(cor_network) == 0)
    cor_network <- igraph::delete_vertices(cor_network, nodes_to_remove)
  }
  cor_betweenness <- igraph::betweenness(cor_network,directed=FALSE)
  
  cor_network <- cor_network |>
     igraph::set_vertex_attr("betweenness", value = cor_betweenness)

  if(igraph::ecount(cor_network) == 0) {
    cluster_membership <- stats::setNames(
      seq_len(igraph::vcount(cor_network)),
      igraph::V(cor_network)$name
    )
  } else {
    cluster_membership <- igraph::membership(cluster_louvain_stable(cor_network))
  }
  display_network <- cor_network
  if(!is.na(cluster)) {
    selected_vertices <- which(cluster_membership == cluster)
    display_network <- igraph::induced_subgraph(cor_network, vids = selected_vertices)
  }
  if(igraph::vcount(display_network) == 0) {
    module_count <- 0
    modularity_value <- NA_real_
  } else if(igraph::ecount(display_network) == 0) {
    module_count <- igraph::vcount(display_network)
    modularity_value <- 0
  } else {
    display_cluster <- cluster_louvain_stable(display_network)
    module_count <- length(unique(igraph::membership(display_cluster)))
    modularity_value <- igraph::modularity(display_cluster)
  }
  cluster_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))
  palette <- cluster_palette(length(unique(cluster_membership)))
  vertex_ids <- unname(igraph::V(cor_network)$name)
  vertex_metadata <- node_display_metadata[match(vertex_ids, node_display_metadata$Node_ID), ]
  vertex_labels <- unname(vertex_metadata$Node_Label)
  vertex_labels[is.na(vertex_labels)] <- vertex_ids[is.na(vertex_labels)]
  node_colors <- unname(palette[as.numeric(cluster_membership)])
  average_values <- unname(node_average_lookup[vertex_ids])

  if(color_nodes_by_average) {
    average_scale_max <- max(abs(average_values), na.rm = TRUE)
    if(is.finite(average_scale_max) && average_scale_max > 0) {
      average_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(201)
      average_indices <- round(((average_values + average_scale_max) / (2 * average_scale_max)) * 200) + 1
      average_indices[!is.finite(average_indices)] <- NA_integer_
      average_indices <- pmin(pmax(average_indices, 1), 201)
      node_colors <- average_palette[average_indices]
      node_colors[is.na(node_colors)] <- "grey"
    } else {
      node_colors <- rep("white", length(vertex_ids))
      node_colors[is.na(average_values)] <- "grey"
    }
  }
  
  if(!color_nodes_by_average && any(!is.na(node_display_metadata$Color_Factor))) {
    node_color_lookup <- node_display_metadata |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Color_Factor), Color_Factor != "") |>
      dplyr::distinct(Node_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
    if(user_palette) {
      metadata_node_colors <- node_color_lookup$Color_Factor
    } else {
      color_levels <- unique(node_color_lookup$Color_Factor)
      color_palette <- grDevices::hcl.colors(length(color_levels), palette = "Spectral")
      names(color_palette) <- color_levels
      metadata_node_colors <- color_palette[node_color_lookup$Color_Factor]
    }
    names(metadata_node_colors) <- node_color_lookup$Node_ID
    node_colors <- unname(metadata_node_colors[vertex_ids])
    missing_node_colors <- is.na(node_colors)
    node_colors[missing_node_colors] <- "grey"
  }

  if(is_bipartite) {
    node_shapes <- unname(ifelse(vertex_metadata$Partition == "Node", "square", "dot"))
    node_shapes[is.na(node_shapes)] <- "dot"
  } else {
    node_shapes <- rep("dot", length(vertex_ids))
  }

  if(any(!is.na(node_display_metadata$Shape_Factor))) {
    node_shape_lookup <- node_display_metadata |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(Shape_Factor), Shape_Factor != "") |>
      dplyr::distinct(Node_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
    metadata_node_shapes <- node_shape_lookup$Shape_Factor
    names(metadata_node_shapes) <- node_shape_lookup$Node_ID
    matched_shapes <- metadata_node_shapes[vertex_ids]
    node_shapes[!is.na(matched_shapes)] <- unname(matched_shapes[!is.na(matched_shapes)])
  }
  
  igraph::V(cor_network)$frame.color <- "white"
  igraph::V(cor_network)$frame.width <- 0
  cor_network_df <- igraph::as_long_data_frame(cor_network)
  nodes <- data.frame(id = vertex_ids,
                      group = unname(as.numeric(cluster_membership)),
                      label = vertex_labels,
                      ## value = (cor_betweenness/max(cor_betweenness))*15,
                      color=node_colors,
                      ## font.size = (cor_betweenness+.1)/max(cor_betweenness),
                      title = paste0("<p><b>", "</b><br>Name:", vertex_labels,
                                     "<p><b>", "</b><br>Module:", unname(as.numeric(cluster_membership)),
                                     "<p><b>", "</b><br>Betweenness: ", unname(cor_betweenness),
                                     "<p><b>", "</b><br>Average value: ", round(average_values, 3)),
                      shape = node_shapes,
                      row.names = NULL
                      )
  edges <- data.frame(from = cor_network_df$from_name,
                      to = cor_network_df$to_name,
                      width = unname(igraph::E(cor_network)$weight/max(igraph::E(cor_network)$weight)),
                      color = unname(igraph::E(cor_network)$color),
                      row.names = NULL
                      )
  if(!is.na(cluster)) {
    nodes <- nodes |>
      dplyr::filter(group == cluster)
    edges <- edges |>
      dplyr::filter(from %in% nodes$id & to %in% nodes$id)
  }
  return(list(nodes, edges, module_count = module_count, modularity = modularity_value))
}

make_network_visual <- function(nodes, edges) {
    return(visNetwork::visNetwork(nodes, edges,height = "2000px", width = "100%")|>
           visNetwork::visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE) |>
           visNetwork::visPhysics(stabilization = FALSE) |>
           visNetwork::visEdges(smooth = FALSE) |>
           visNetwork::visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_nicely"))
}
```

```{r}
                                  min = 0, max = 1, value = .1, step = 0.01),

 shinydashboard::sidebarSearchForm(textId = "searchText", buttonId = "searchButton", label = "Zoom node..."),

        "Current Network Stats | Modules: ",
        ifelse(input$pick_module == "",
               current_network$module_count,1),
        " | Modularity: ", modularity_text
      )
    })
    shiny::observe({
      if(input$searchButton > 0) {
        shiny::isolate({
          current_node <- reactive_network()[[1]] |>
            dplyr::filter(label == input$searchText) |>
            dplyr::pull(id)
          if(length(current_node) > 0) {
            visNetwork::visNetworkProxy("mynetwork") |> visNetwork::visFocus(id = current_node[[1]])
          }
        })
      }
    })
  },

  options = list(height = "950px")
)
```
